usedFor: Todoist holds quick tasks and TeamGantt holds your project plan, so “New Task Created in Project” can run “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Task” in TeamGantt
bestTemplate.why: Each new Todoist task shows up in the Gantt plan, so scheduling sees work captured elsewhere.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so tasks reach TeamGantt after a scheduled check.
